name: Abu Gharaq

queries.query: Abu Gharaq Iraq official cadastral map parcel Ministry of Justice real estate registration; Iraq official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry Abu Gharaq
queries.result: First-party discovery found Iraq Ministry of Justice material identifying a Real Estate Registration Directorate in Abu Gharaq, Babylon, and an official Ur Portal service for requesting a property deed and property map. registryEvidence.custodian: Iraq Ministry of Justice, General Real Estate Registration Department, with a specifically reported Real Estate Registration Directorate in Abu Gharaq, Babylon.
registryEvidence.scope: The Ministry of Justice first-party article reports a directorate in Abu Gharaq; the national department page describes the department's land-registration remit. This establishes local registry custody context, not open parcel-data coverage.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official Abu Gharaq announcement concerns a real-estate-registration office and services. It does not publish a downloadable/open parcel layer, city boundary, schema, CRS, or anonymous geometry API. The WUP point was retained exactly and was not shifted to seek a hit.
